text.arabic_uthmani: لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُۥ لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْحِسَابِ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ

words.gloss_range: initial allocation lām assigning the promised outcome to the responder-class
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) opens the ayah as an allocation frame: the coming good is for the responders before the reward word is named. Its fused position with the relative class makes belonging and beneficiary status the first movement of the verse.

topics.headline: beneficiary verdict opens first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by assigning an outcome to a group before narrating anything about reward.
topics.reason: The lām governs the following relative pronoun and sets beneficiary/possession force at the front of the clause.

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun forming the responder class
words.prose: {{ar:الَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) forms a definite class whose identity is supplied by the following response verb. It also prepares the mirrored class marker later in the ayah, so the two human groups are sorted by matching grammar before their actions diverge.

topics.headline: group defined by response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the blessed group is not named by tribe or status but by the clause of response that follows.
topics.reason: The definite relative pronoun creates an identifiable class and anticipates the second matched relative pronoun.

words.gloss_range: completed Form X response to the divine call, with effortful answer rather than passive hearing
words.root_gloss_range: answering and responding, with an older image of cutting through or traversing; local Form X selects active response while allowing the crossing image to color it

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negated Form X response mirrored later in the ayah

words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَجَابُوا}} ({{tr:istajābū}}) presents the first class through a completed Form X response. The root image can suggest crossing through a gap, but the local sense is active answering: they move toward the call of their Lord, and the same stem will return under negation in {{ar:يَسْتَجِيبُوا}} ({{tr:yastajībū}}).

topics.headline: completed response crosses toward the call
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that response is completed, effortful, and formally mirrored by the later negated response.
topics.reason: The perfect Form X morphology, the following lām complement, and the intra-ayah echo with word 10 preserve the response topic while narrowing the root image to a supporting image.

words.gloss_range: directional/complement lām marking the one responded to
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) after the response verb marks the target of answering. It carries directional force and fills the verb complement, so the response is immediately routed toward the Lord rather than left as a general moral quality.

topics.headline: response routed to the Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that response is not abstract virtue; it is grammatically directed to a specific addressee.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:رَبِّهِمُ}} ({{tr:rabbihimu}}) and completes the verb's response axis.

words.gloss_range: their Lord as the relational addressee of response
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, nurture, sustaining, and regulation; local noun selects relational Lordship with personal suffix

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: pronoun that recalls the same divine addressee

words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّهِمُ}} ({{tr:rabbihimu}}) names the addressee relationally: their Lord, not a detached title. The root field holds ownership, nurture, and governance, while the suffix makes the relation personal before the later pronoun {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahū}}) recalls Him.

topics.headline: their Lord is the one answered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the response is owed to a personalized Lordship relation that combines authority and care.
topics.reason: The genitive form is governed by lām, the suffix personalizes the relation, and the root family supports Lordship as authority joined to care.

words.gloss_range: the definite superlative good, left unnamed as a total outcome
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, goodness, excellence, and better/best outcome; local feminine elative nominalizes the best good without an expressed head noun
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-ḥusnā}}) closes the first clause with a definite superlative good but leaves the head noun unstated. The reward is therefore the best outcome as a whole, and its compactness contrasts with the long unfolding of ransom failure, bad reckoning, Gehenna, and the wretched bed.

topics.headline: the best remains open and total
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise is compact and open-ended, while the opposing punishment branch is expanded in detail.
topics.reason: The nominative definite feminine elative can function in the nominal clause without an expressed noun, and the ayah-level structure contrasts its compact promise with the expanded negative branch.

words.gloss_range: coordinating and contrastive connector opening the non-responder clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) links the two class clauses while pivoting from the compact promise to the expanded non-response scene. The connector preserves grammatical mirroring without softening the antithesis.

topics.headline: turn from promise to refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second class is linked to the first but turned into its opposite.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates two complete relative clauses and marks the discourse shift into the negative branch.

words.gloss_range: second definite relative pronoun forming the non-responder class
words.prose: {{ar:الَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) repeats the earlier class-forming pronoun, so the second group enters through the same grammatical frame as the first. The difference is not in class architecture but in the negated response that follows.

topics.headline: same class frame, opposite outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the non-responders are grammatically parallel to the responders before negation divides them.
topics.reason: The repeated definite relative pronoun creates formal parity between the two sorted groups.

words.gloss_range: past-negating jussive particle that defines the second class by non-response
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) stands before the response verb as the hinge of the negative branch. It gives past negation and jussive force, making the second group those for whom the required response did not occur.

topics.headline: negation defines refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second class is created by a visible negation before the response verb.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following verb and turns the relative class into the failed-response class.

words.gloss_range: negated Form X response under jussive governance
words.root_gloss_range: answering and responding, with traversal/crossing imagery; local imperfect Form X is negated by {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}})

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negation particle governing the response verb
completed response form mirrored by the negated form

words.prose: {{ar:يَسْتَجِيبُوا}} ({{tr:yastajībū}}) keeps the same Form X response stem as {{ar:ٱسْتَجَابُوا}} ({{tr:istajābū}}), but {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) pulls it into jussive negation. The possible crossing toward the call is visible only as a blocked response.

topics.headline: same response stem blocked by negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that refusal is expressed by the same response form as the first group, now grammatically blocked.
topics.reason: The morphology mirrors word 3, while the governing negation changes aspect, mood, and polarity.

words.gloss_range: dative pronoun recalling the Lord as the failed-response target

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relational title resumed by the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahū}}) compresses the full relation of {{ar:رَبِّهِمُ}} ({{tr:rabbihimu}}) into a preposition plus pronoun. It keeps the failed response aimed at Him and carries the referent forward from relational title to compact anaphora.

topics.headline: the same Lord recalled by pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failure is still directed toward the already named Lord, even though He is now compressed into a pronoun.
topics.reason: The compound form functions as the complement of the negated response verb and resumes the divine addressee.

words.gloss_range: counterfactual condition particle opening the impossible ransom scenario
words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) opens an unreal condition, not a real escape route. The verse now stages maximal possession so the later self-ransom attempt can fail against the largest imaginable terms.

topics.headline: unreal possession scene opens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah grants the strongest impossible scenario before showing that ransom still fails.
topics.reason: The following embedded possession clause and apodosis lām select counterfactual condition force.

words.gloss_range: embedding particle giving the hypothetical possession clause assertive weight

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: counterfactual particle governing the embedded condition

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) gives the unreal possession scene the shape of a complete embedded assertion. Inside {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}), that weight makes the concession feel as strong as possible before the ransom answer arrives.

topics.headline: the unreal condition is fully staged
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the imagined possession is grammatically treated as a full concession before it is rendered useless.
topics.reason: The particle binds the counterfactual condition tightly to its possession content.

words.gloss_range: possessive lām assigning the hypothetical wealth to the non-responders

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: possessive lām plus plural pronoun unit

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) in {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}) assigns the imagined wealth to the non-responders themselves. The possession relation is made compact before the vast object of possession unfolds.

topics.headline: they are granted ownership for the test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the counterfactual removes lack of ownership as an excuse before ransom fails.
topics.reason: The bound lām plus plural pronoun creates the possessive unit inside the counterfactual.

words.gloss_range: plural pronoun fixing the hypothetical possessors as the failed-response class
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) keeps the possessors plural and continuous with the failed-response group. The ayah imagines the whole ransom economy as belonging to them collectively.

topics.headline: the same group owns the imagined ransom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole imagined fortune remains tied to the same non-responder class.
topics.reason: The bound plural pronoun in {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}) resumes the earlier plural class and verbs.

words.gloss_range: open relative object broadened into whatever is in the earth
words.prose: {{ar:مَّا}} ({{tr:mā}}) begins the possessed object as an open "whatever." The following locative phrase and totality marker then expand that openness into everything contained in the earth.

topics.headline: whatever becomes the total object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how an initially open object becomes the largest conceivable material total.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is resolved by {{ar:فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا}} ({{tr:fī al-arḍi jamīʿan}}), creating the total-resource unit.

words.gloss_range: containment preposition making the earth the domain of the ransom total
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the earth the container for the imagined wealth. In the movement from 13:17 to 13:18, the same earth shifts from the place where true benefit remains to the storehouse whose total contents still cannot ransom.

topics.headline: the earth contains the ransom total
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the imagined ransom is not just earthly in topic but contained within the terrestrial domain.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the earth noun and participates in the recurrent earth-total ransom wording attested in judgment contexts such as 3:91, 5:36, 10:54, and 39:47.

words.gloss_range: the definite singular earth as total terrestrial resource-domain
words.root_gloss_range: earth, ground, land, territory, and floor/bottom; local phrase selects the total terrestrial domain by containment and totality markers

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition governing the earth noun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) is governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) and made definite singular, so the phrase selects the earth as one total domain rather than scattered territories. The ransom formula also echoes judgment passages where all that is in the earth cannot buy escape (3:91; 5:36; 10:54; 39:47).

topics.headline: the whole earth as ransom domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the counterfactual is maximal: one definite earth and everything in it are imagined as payment.
topics.reason: The local construction narrows the broader earth/land field to a total terrestrial-resource domain inside a known ransom-futility formula.

words.gloss_range: accusative totality marker gathering the earth contents as all together
words.root_gloss_range: gathering, collecting, assembling, and totality; local accusative adverbial marks the possessed contents as entirely gathered
words.prose: {{ar:جَمِيعًا}} ({{tr:jamīʿan}}) makes the contents of the earth "all together" as the state of the possessed object. The gathering root turns the wealth into one aggregate, and the next phrase reopens that completed total by adding its equivalent.

topics.headline: all of it is gathered, then doubled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the imagined payment reaches totality once and then is escalated beyond totality by an equal duplicate.
topics.reason: The accusative ḥāl/adverbial role and the following duplicate phrase create maximal payment pressure.

words.gloss_range: coordinator adding the duplicate after totality has already been reached
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) after the totality marker coordinates an added equivalent, not a new scene. Its small connective force becomes escalation because what it adds is a full duplicate of the already completed total.

topics.headline: and adds a full duplicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connector does not merely list another item; it escalates from all wealth to all wealth plus its equal.
topics.reason: The conjunction links {{ar:مِثْلَهُ}} ({{tr:mithlahū}}) to the possessed object after {{ar:جَمِيعًا}} ({{tr:jamīʿan}}).

words.gloss_range: an exact equivalent of the total, with parable-family echo retained as background
words.root_gloss_range: likeness, similitude, example, parable, equal, and counterpart; local ransom frame selects exact equivalent while echoing the parable root from 13:17
words.prose: {{ar:مِثْلَهُ}} ({{tr:mithlahū}}) selects exact equivalence in the ransom frame: a second amount equal to the already totalized earth-contents. The broader parable/likeness family remains audible because 13:17 used the same root for divine examples, so likeness shifts from explanation to failed price.

topics.headline: likeness becomes failed price
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root of parable and likeness turns from divine explanation in 13:17 into an equal duplicate offered as futile ransom in 13:18.
topics.reason: The suffix points back to the first total, the ransom context narrows the broad likeness field to equivalent double, and the 13:17 boundary preserves the parable-root echo.

words.gloss_range: accompaniment adverb keeping the duplicate with the original total
words.root_gloss_range: accompaniment and togetherness; local adverb marks the equal amount as present alongside the first total
words.prose: {{ar:مَعَهُ}} ({{tr:maʿahū}}) closes the doubled-possession phrase by making the equivalent accompany the first total. The pronoun ties the accompaniment to the same object already doubled, so the ransom price is complete before the apodosis begins.

topics.headline: the duplicate is with the first total
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the duplicate is added alongside the first total, not substituted for it.
topics.reason: The accusative adverb of accompaniment and attached pronoun specify simultaneity with the first total.

words.gloss_range: apodosis lām marking the expected answer to the counterfactual condition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: counterfactual particle answered by the apodosis lām

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) prefixed to the ransom verb marks the answer to {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}). It makes the self-ransom attempt the certain consequent of the unreal possession scenario.

topics.headline: the condition certainly yields a ransom attempt
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the counterfactual grants certainty to the attempt, even though the surrounding verdict denies its success.
topics.reason: The lām is attached directly to the perfect verb as the apodosis marker of the counterfactual.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII self-ransom in an unreal apodosis
words.root_gloss_range: ransom, redemption, compensation, and exchange; local Form VIII makes the actors attempt self-release by payment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱفْتَدَوْا}} ({{tr:iftadaw}}) is the self-ransom verb in the answer to the unreal condition. Form VIII makes the actors both payers and intended beneficiaries, and the formula belongs to ransom-futility passages where material payment fails before judgment (3:91; 5:36; 10:54; 39:47).

topics.headline: they would ransom themselves with everything
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the doubled wealth is converted into a self-directed release price that still cannot save them.
topics.reason: The apodosis scope, Form VIII morphology, rare root field, and formulaic cooccurrence all converge on futile self-release.

words.gloss_range: instrument/price phrase reducing the doubled total to the thing paid with
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِ}} ({{tr:bihī}}) marks the doubled wealth as the means and price of the attempted ransom. The tiny pronoun compresses everything in the earth plus its equivalent into one instrument of exchange before the verdict pivots.

topics.headline: the whole doubled fortune becomes one instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the vast doubled total is compressed into a single pronoun as the price of ransom.
topics.reason: The bāʾ supplies instrument/price force and the pronoun resumes the entire preceding wealth phrase.

words.gloss_range: distal plural demonstrative gathering the failed-response group for verdict
words.root_gloss_range: demonstrative/deictic field; local form points back to a plural class with evaluative distance
words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) points back to the non-responders after the failed ransom scenario. The distal plural demonstrative resets the syntax and creates distance before the assigned verdict begins.

topics.headline: those ones are pointed out for judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the long hypothetical scene is gathered back into a distanced demonstrative before judgment is assigned.
topics.reason: The demonstrative resumes the preceding class and turns the counterfactual scene into judicial declaration.

words.gloss_range: possessive/allocation lām assigning bad reckoning to them
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) in the verdict repeats allocation grammar, but now the assigned thing is bad reckoning. The form moves from imagined possession and earlier reward framing into adverse outcome.

topics.headline: allocation grammar turns adverse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same kind of "for them" frame that began with reward now assigns bad reckoning.
topics.reason: The possessive lām governs the plural pronoun and introduces the nominal verdict phrase.

words.gloss_range: plural pronoun carrying the condemned group through the verdict chain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: distal demonstrative resumed by the verdict pronoun
verdict allocation phrase with plural pronoun
later abode noun carrying the same group forward

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) in {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}) anchors the verdict to {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) and begins the pronoun chain continued in {{ar:مَأْوَىٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:maʾwāhum}}). The exact phrase for bad reckoning also returns in 13:21, where the righteous fear what this group receives.

topics.headline: one group receives the whole closing verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bad reckoning, abode, and final coda remain attached to the same non-responder group.
topics.reason: The plural pronoun keeps the demonstrative group attached to the reckoning and abode sequence, with same-surah echo at 13:21.

words.gloss_range: construct head naming the evil or severity of the reckoning
words.root_gloss_range: badness, evil, harm, ugliness, and evil deed; local construct makes badness the head of the reckoning phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: superlative good opposed by the evil of reckoning
reckoning noun governed by the construct head

words.prose: {{ar:سُوٓءُ}} ({{tr:sūʾu}}) heads the construct phrase with {{ar:ٱلْحِسَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥisābi}}), making badness inseparable from the reckoning itself. It also answers {{ar:ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-ḥusnā}}) across the ayah, setting superlative good against the evil of account.

topics.headline: badness is built into the reckoning phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is not merely a bad experience of accounting; evil is the head term governing the reckoning.
topics.reason: The nominative construct gerund and the antonymic relation with word 6 preserve the bad-reckoning topic.

words.gloss_range: the definite reckoning as known eschatological accounting and judgment
words.root_gloss_range: counting, calculating, reckoning, accounting, sufficiency, and evaluative judgment; local abstract noun names the accounting process rather than the accountant

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening reward word in near-sound opposition

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحِسَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥisābi}}) completes the construct as the domain in which badness is realized. The definite article points to the known reckoning, while the root field joins counting, calculation, sufficiency, and judgment; its near sound with {{ar:ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-ḥusnā}}) keeps reward and account structurally opposed.

topics.headline: the known account is exact and evaluative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reckoning is a definite known process, exact enough to count and evaluative enough to judge.
topics.reason: The genitive definite abstract noun completes the iḍāfa and carries the accounting/judgment field into the verdict.

words.gloss_range: coordinator adding the abode verdict after bad reckoning
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds a second verdict clause after bad reckoning. It keeps the abode statement separate from the construct phrase and lets the closing sequence move cumulatively from account to destination.

topics.headline: reckoning is followed by abode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the punishment sequence accumulates: account is not the last word before destination is named.
topics.reason: The independent conjunction coordinates a fresh nominal clause headed by {{ar:مَأْوَىٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:maʾwāhum}}).

words.gloss_range: their assigned place of return/refuge, inverted into punishment by its predicate
words.root_gloss_range: seeking shelter, refuge, return, and place of resort; local noun of place with suffix selects shelter/return against alternative root possibilities

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: predicate naming the punitive destination

words.prose: {{ar:مَأْوَىٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:maʾwāhum}}) is a noun of place with their suffix, so the destination is personally assigned. The local predicate {{ar:جَهَنَّمُ}} ({{tr:jahannamu}}) selects the shelter/return root over alternative possibilities and turns refuge language into punishment; the formula recurs with Gehenna in 3:151, 8:16, and 9:73.

topics.headline: their shelter-word becomes punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the bitter inversion: the word of refuge and return is assigned to them as Gehenna.
topics.reason: The noun-of-place form, suffix, predicate, root-dispute evidence, and formulaic cooccurrence converge on refuge inversion.

words.gloss_range: proper named punishment-place functioning as predicate of their abode
words.root_gloss_range: foreign proper-name field associated with Gehenna and depth/pit imagery; local use is the definite named destination

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: shelter-word before the named destination
bed-word after the named destination

words.prose: {{ar:جَهَنَّمُ}} ({{tr:jahannamu}}) is the nominative predicate that identifies their abode. As a proper foreign name it needs no article, and the depth/pit associations are only supporting imagery; locally the name pivots between {{ar:مَأْوَىٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:maʾwāhum}}) and {{ar:ٱلْمِهَادُ}} ({{tr:al-mihādu}}), making the destination both abode and bed.

topics.headline: Gehenna names and anchors the destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proper name sits between shelter and bed terms, anchoring the final verdict as both abode and resting-place.
topics.reason: The predicate role is local and primary, while foreign-name and pit imagery are retained as narrowed supporting pressure.

words.gloss_range: final connector introducing the exclamatory coda

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: dispraise verb introduced by the connector

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before {{ar:بِئْسَ}} ({{tr:biʾsa}}) continues the verdict and turns it toward exclamatory condemnation. After the abode has been named, this connector lets the final phrase function as an evaluative seal.

topics.headline: the verdict turns into condemnation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final connector does not narrate another event; it seals the verdict with evaluation.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces a new coda clause after the abode-identification.

words.gloss_range: frozen verb of dispraise condemning the final resting-place
words.root_gloss_range: wretchedness, misery, severity, force, and dispraise; local frozen form functions as exclamatory condemnation rather than ordinary past action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fixed dispraise formula closing the punishment sequence

words.prose: {{ar:بِئْسَ}} ({{tr:biʾsa}}) is a frozen verb of dispraise: formally verbal but functioning as exclamatory condemnation. Its root field adds severity to wretchedness, and the formula {{ar:بِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ}} ({{tr:biʾsa al-mihādu}}) recurs as a punishment coda in 2:206, 3:12, 3:197, and 38:56.

topics.headline: frozen dispraise closes argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ending is not neutral description but a fixed act of condemnation over the destination.
topics.reason: The uninflected dispraise form, root semantics, and repeated coda formula preserve the final-condemnation topic.

words.gloss_range: the definite resting-place/bed condemned as the final prepared foundation
words.root_gloss_range: smoothing, spreading, preparing, bed, cradle, and foundation; local noun is the specified object of dispraise after Gehenna

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: named punishment-place preceding the bed-word

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمِهَادُ}} ({{tr:al-mihādu}}) is the specified object of dispraise and the ayah's last word. Its bed, cradle, smoothing, and preparation field becomes ironic after {{ar:جَهَنَّمُ}} ({{tr:jahannamu}}): the prepared resting-place is punishment, and the echo with earth as a spread-out cradle in 78:6 sharpens the inversion.

topics.headline: the last word turns bed into punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word lands on bed/cradle imagery inverted into a prepared punishment foundation.
topics.reason: The nominative specified noun, final position, bed/preparation root field, repeated punishment formula, and 78:6 echo converge on closure irony.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الرب بمعنى الله تعالى، ومالك الشيء، وسيده المطاع، وصاحبه، ورب الدار والدابة والملك
branches.scope_en: Includes rabb as God, an owner, an obeyed master, a possessor, and the lord of a house, animal, or king.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ج و ب forms at words 2 and 7 oppose response to nonresponse, then word 18 introduces attempted ransom.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same response construction governs both groups, but only the first enters a relation with their Lord and receives the good. The second cannot replace that missing relation with a transfer of possessions; response and ransom are deliberately non-equivalent operations.

activation_trace.role: Reply and answering supply the reciprocal act whose presence or absence divides the two outcomes.
Lordship and ownership make the response relational and expose the futility of paying the owner with owned things.
Beneficent good supplies an outcome received within the responsive relation, not a commodity bought afterward.
Substitution by a saving payment supplies the failed rival mechanism to response.

changed_reading.before: The ayah assigns reward for obedience and punishment for disobedience.
changed_reading.after: The ayah contrasts a reciprocal answer that cannot be purchased with a late attempt to substitute owned quantity for an unanswered relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 14-18 maximize the proposed payment as all the earth plus its equal, while word 23 names the account.
baseline_models.mechanism: The hypothetical assembles completeness, duplication, and substitution, then declares the account bad. The sufficiency branch of ح س ب lets سوء الحساب mean not only severe reckoning but an account against which even a doubled total proves radically insufficient.

activation_trace.role: The whole lower realm supplies the maximal spatial extent of the imagined asset base.
Wholeness without loss supplies explicit completeness rather than merely a large amount.
An equal counterpart doubles the supposedly complete total.
A saving substitute turns the doubled total into a proposed settlement.
Sufficiency and adequacy recast the bad account as a deficit no quantity can cover.

changed_reading.before: All earthly wealth, even doubled, would not be accepted as ransom.
changed_reading.after: The ayah runs a limit test on quantity: complete possession, duplication, and substitution still yield an account defined by non-sufficiency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 22-27 move without a new subject from bad account to refuge, Hell, blame, and bed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The legal register of account is converted into spatial and material emplacement. Reckoning is not followed by an unrelated penalty; it resolves into where the nonresponders gather, what receives them, and what has been prepared as their resting surface.

activation_trace.role: Badness and defect qualify the account and begin the descent from judgment into condition.
Counting and reckoning supply the adjudicative stage that is translated into habitat.
Gathering into a shelter turns judgment into an assigned destination.
The formal word of blame evaluates the final emplacement rather than adding a separate event.
Preparation and leveling make the bed the completed material form of the preceding account.

changed_reading.before: A bad reckoning is followed by Hell as punishment.
changed_reading.after: The reckoning materializes as an anti-home: account, gathering-place, and prepared bed are stages of one terminal emplacement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The response is explicitly to their رب at word 3 and its outcome is الحسنى at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The تربـية and growth branches around ر ب ب/ر ب و activate the Lord not only as commander but as one who brings something to completion by stages. The utmost-good branch of ح س ن then makes الحسنى the ripened limit of that formation rather than an arbitrary prize.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion supply a staged formative relation behind Lordship.
Growth through nourishment preserves the non-dominant mapped root as a live developmental image.
The utmost limit or full effort casts الحسنى as the culminating good of that formation.

changed_reading.before: Their Lord grants responders the best reward.
changed_reading.after: Responding admits them into an ongoing formative relation whose matured limit is الحسنى.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:6 names a demand that accelerates evil ahead of good, while 13:18 restores the order الحسنى then سوء الحساب. Response can therefore be read as receptivity to the offered good, whereas nonresponse includes an inverted appetite that demands harmful proof first.

activation_trace.role: Hastening and advancing supply the temporal pressure that pushes evil out of order.
Badness supplies the demanded object that is perversely pulled forward.
Precedence explicitly orders one outcome ahead of another and makes reversal diagnostic.
Goodness supplies the displaced positive term that 13:18 restores to first position.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer blocks a simplistic immediate-retaliation mechanism.
The focus ayah places the good outcome first and supplies the corrected order.

structural_cues: 13:6 says السيئة قبل الحسنة, whereas 13:18 presents الحسنى before سوء الحساب; 13:6 also holds forgiveness and severe consequence together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reversed word order and delayed forgiveness; I infer that response includes accepting the proper order of address and outcome. A live alternative is that 13:6 and 13:18 only contrast impatience with final judgment.

changed_reading.before: The two groups simply receive opposite final outcomes.
changed_reading.after: The division also diagnoses temporal desire: responders receive good, while nonresponders have already shown an urge to drag evil ahead of good as proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:14 renders nonresponse as a broken relay: a call is issued, hands extend toward water, but water does not reach the mouth. That material non-arrival sharpens 13:18: positive response completes a reciprocal circuit, while the later ransom is a second imagined transfer that also cannot arrive at its goal.

activation_trace.role: Calling and drawing by speech supply the initiating signal of the relay.
Answering supplies the explicitly failed reciprocal link that the focus repeats.
Extending the hand materializes an offered but ineffective reach.
The outstretched palm supplies a posture of request without successful receipt.
Literal water supplies the desired medium that remains physically separated from the requester.
Arrival at a goal supplies the repeatedly negated completion condition.
The proposed saving transfer becomes a second failed attempt to bridge nonresponse.

structural_cues: 13:14 orders call, nonresponse, extended palms, water, mouth, and failed arrival; 13:18 repeats the response polarity before introducing payment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a verbal failure embodied as failed reaching; I carry that transfer logic into the focus ransom. The alternative is to keep the water simile limited to false invocation and treat ransom as a separate legal image.

changed_reading.before: Responders obey, and nonresponders later offer an unacceptable ransom.
changed_reading.after: Response is successful relational arrival; nonresponse and ransom are two versions of a transfer that never reaches its intended endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:15 places everything in the heavens and earth, willingly or unwillingly, inside a field of prostration. Thus 13:18's nonresponders are not outside all response; they refuse willing answer while their bodies, world, and shadows remain structurally submitted. Their fantasy of owning all earth for ransom is also compromised because the proposed asset already answers to the same Lord.

activation_trace.role: Lowering and submission supply the universal responsive field beneath deliberate answer.
The lower realm itself is included among the submitting entities later imagined as property.
Willing compliance supplies the mode that most closely matches positive response.
Being carried into what is disliked supplies submission without willing answer.
The shadow of a standing body supplies an involuntary responder attached to each person.
Ransom exposes the impossible attempt to transfer an already-submitted world as independent property.

structural_cues: 13:15 totalizes heavens and earth, contrasts willing and unwilling modes, and adds shadows at recurring times.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal prostration and the focus's hypothetical possession of all earth; I infer that earth cannot function as an external bargaining asset. The alternative is that 13:15 only establishes sovereignty without qualifying the ransom image.

changed_reading.before: Some people respond and others simply do not.
changed_reading.after: The true contrast is willing relational response versus refusal within unavoidable submission, and the earth offered as ransom is already inside that submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding water-and-fire process sorts contents by capacity, truth, benefit, and persistence: rising foam is discarded while useful matter remains in earth. 13:18 then reads less like an isolated verdict and more like the disclosed result of an assay. Responsive capacity retains benefit; spectacular volume, even all earth doubled, cannot ransom what proves foam-like or nonpersistent.

activation_trace.role: Flowing runoff supplies the transport process through which contents are exposed and sorted.
A valley as the course of floodwater supplies differentiated receiving capacity.
A measure that reaches a thing's limit constrains each channel independently of apparent total volume.
Floating foam supplies conspicuous excess that rises yet has no durable efficacy.
Truth as stable correspondence supplies the criterion that survives the assay.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the failure mode of what disappears.
Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the positive value that survives sorting.
Remaining with patient stability supplies the positive material result of the sorting process.
Soft productive earth supplies the receiving place in which useful matter remains.
The focus's complete total becomes a deliberate stress test showing that volume is not persistence.

structural_cues: 13:17 immediately precedes the focus and repeats parallel water and smelting processes before contrasting disappearance with remaining in earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured channels, floating residue, stable truth, and remaining benefit; I infer a process-to-verdict arrow into 13:18. The live alternative is that the parable illustrates truth and falsehood generally without modeling the two response groups materially.

changed_reading.before: The ayah announces two externally assigned destinies.
changed_reading.after: The destinies are also assay results: response is capacity that receives and retains benefit, while amassed but unstable excess cannot become saving value.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:20-25 unfolds the two respondent classes as opposed network operations. The first complete and preserve covenant, join what is to be joined, and place good against evil; the second unbind covenant and cut connection. استجابوا therefore expands from a verbal answer into sustained connective conduct, and الحسنى becomes an active good before it is an outcome.

activation_trace.role: Answering supplies the compact focus act that the following conduct unpacks.
Completion without deficiency turns response into maintained fulfillment.
A protected covenant supplies the relation that continued response preserves.
Joining one thing to another supplies the constructive social operation of response.
Doing beneficent good makes الحسنى operative as a force placed against evil.
Undoing what was bound supplies the inverse operation of nonresponse.
Severing a connection supplies the social topology produced by refusal.

structural_cues: 13:22 root د ر ء at word 13 has no branch inventory, so only its construction, placing الحسنة against السيئة, supplies the reversal cue.
13:20-25 repeats والذين and mirrors fulfillment/joining against unbinding/cutting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored relational operations after the focus; I infer that they unpack the functional content of response and nonresponse. A live alternative is that they list consequences of belief rather than define the response mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Response is a single act of assent that earns good.
changed_reading.after: Response is a maintained topology of fulfilling, joining, and answering evil with enacted good; nonresponse materializes as unbinding and severance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence gives the positive counterpart to the focus's evil refuge and bed: entry through every gate, greeting of safety, hearts settling through remembrance, and حسن مآب. The good is therefore simultaneously future habitation, relational welcome, and a present settling of the inner place.

activation_trace.role: Gathering into refuge supplies the negative spatial endpoint that the later return reverses.
Entering an interior supplies actual inhabitation rather than abstract reward.
A doorway supplies repeated access and welcome into the good endpoint.
Safety from harm supplies the social and affective quality of the inhabited outcome.
Stillness and tranquility supply a present inward analogue of settled abode.
Recollection that keeps something present supplies the process by which the heart settles.
Goodness explicitly qualifies the return and binds the later home back to الحسنى.
Return to a home supplies the positive counterpart to the focus's evil refuge.

structural_cues: 13:23-24 moves through entry, doors, and greeting; 13:28 repeats heart-settling twice; 13:29 closes with حسن مآب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spatial entry, safety, repeated tranquility, and good return; I infer one habitation mechanism spanning present heart and final abode. The alternative keeps inward tranquility and eschatological home as parallel but separate benefits.

changed_reading.before: الحسنى is an unspecified reward opposite Hell.
changed_reading.after: الحسنى is a settled return already anticipated in a heart that finds rest, then completed as entered, welcomed, safe habitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:39-41 places erasure and establishment with God, assigns the account to the divine side, depicts earth itself being diminished at its edges, and calls the account swift. The focus's proposed ransom is therefore not merely too small: both the ledger and the supposedly total asset are under the authority of the one reckoning.

activation_trace.role: Erasure of an effect supplies sovereign control over what remains on the ledger.
Fixity and continuance supply the complementary authority to establish what endures.
Reckoning explicitly assigned to the divine side identifies who controls the account.
The same lower realm imagined as total ransom becomes the object being acted upon.
Loss of part of a thing makes the proposed total asset visibly unstable.
Edges and limits locate where the apparently complete earth is reduced.
Speed removes the temporal space in which a late compensating transfer might be imagined.
The focus's failed sufficiency is explained by control of both valuation and asset.

structural_cues: 13:40 contrasts the messenger's duty with وعلينا الحساب; 13:41 says no one can reverse the judgment before naming swift account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine erasure/establishment, ownership of account, and diminishing earth; I infer that the ransom fails because payer, asset, and ledger are not independent. The alternative treats these as separate sovereignty statements rather than an explanation of 13:18's failed payment.

changed_reading.before: The ransom fails because its amount is inadequate to the sentence.
changed_reading.after: The ransom fails more fundamentally because the reckoner controls valuation, persistence, and the earth offered as payment; there is no external asset from which to bargain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates branch-distant cutting, opening, and disclosure images rather than the ordinary reply branch. It remains anchored in both ج و ب forms and gains coherence from 13:14's failed water-reaching scene. Downstream prose should present it only as a material overlay on response, not as an etymological replacement for استجاب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opposed ج و ب forms at words 2 and 7 can carry an open-channel versus closed-channel contrast.

activation_trace.role: A penetrating cut supplies the act that makes passage through resistant material.
An opening or gap supplies a receptive interior through which an answer can arrive.
Disclosure and clearing supply what becomes visible when the channel opens.
Water supplies the material that would move through a receptive channel but remains apart.
Failed arrival supplies the observable consequence of a channel that never opens.

changed_reading.before: Response is an affirmative verbal act.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, response opens a passage through which address, disclosure, and benefit arrive; refusal leaves the circuit materially closed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses two branches of م ث ل: quantitative equivalence and punitive exemplarity. It remains anchored in focus word 16 and the exact same root at 13:6. Downstream prose should mark it as lexical resonance or grim wordplay, not claim that ومثله syntactically means punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The proposed ومثله at word 16 names an equal counterpart inside the failed ransom.

activation_trace.role: Equivalence supplies the literal doubling by which the nonresponders try to enlarge payment.
Exemplary punishment supplies the latent reversal from offering an equal to being made a warning.
Earlier punitive examples make the non-quantitative branch locally active before the focus.
The failed saving substitute supplies the pivot on which equivalence turns into exemplarity.

changed_reading.before: They would add an equal amount to all the earth to maximize ransom.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the offered 'equal' carries the shadow of the earlier exemplary punishments: failed equivalence reverses into the payer becoming an example.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the nurture branch of رب with the infant-bed branch of مهد inside a Hell scene. It remains anchored at the ayah's two endpoints, their Lord and their bed, and preserves the explicit good/bad polarity. Downstream prose should call it a counter-image of formation, not imply that المهاد loses its ordinary bed sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ayah begins its positive side with لربهم and closes the negative side with بئس المهاد.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion supply the positive formative relation offered to responders.
Growth by nourishment keeps the split-root developmental image active.
An infant's prepared cradle supplies the terminal counter-image to divine nurture.
Explicit blame marks the cradle image as a perverse formation rather than comfort.

changed_reading.before: Responders receive good, while Hell is the nonresponders' terrible bed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the endpoints form a counter-nursery: willing response enters the Lord's maturing care, while refusal culminates in a blamed cradle that fixes rather than grows its occupant.

strongest_changes: 13:14 turns response into successful arrival and makes ransom a second failed transfer.
13:17 turns the verdict into a material assay of capacity, persistence, and benefit rather than quantity.
13:20-25 unfolds response as fulfilling and joining, while nonresponse becomes unbinding and cutting.
13:39-41 show that the reckoner controls both the account and the earth imagined as payment.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses several mechanisms without forcing a single winner: reciprocal answer versus substitution, totality versus sufficiency, assay versus accumulation, connection versus severance, and good return versus anti-home. Its strangest live branch resonances recast response as an aperture, an offered equal as punitive exemplarity, and the evil bed as a counter-image to the Lord's nurture.
remaining_uncertainties: The hydraulic transfer model is strongly sequenced but the extension from failed reaching to failed ransom remains reader-supplied.
The universal-submission model may establish sovereignty without directly denying hypothetical possession.
The aperture, equivalence/exemplar, and counter-nursery readings are intentionally branch-distant and should remain qualified rather than lexicalized.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. `ح س ب/B001` is reckoning and proportion. Nonresponders imagine doubled earthly possession as ransom, but the account remains bad. I infer that the account measures response rather than gross quantity; accumulated things cannot substitute for answered obligation.
2. The response pair follows useful remainder versus froth. I infer that `ٱسْتَجَابُوا` is the human analogue of a channel receiving water effectively. Refusal leaves even total possession causally useless.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayahs 13:20–22 specified response as maintained bonds and practices, correcting any reading of it as verbal assent alone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A failed relation is answered with an impossible substitution.** `ج و ب / B001` is cutting through and `ج و ب / B003` is responding; `ف د ي / B001` is putting something up as ransom or substitute; `ح س ب / B001` is counting and reckoning. The responders open a relation, while the nonresponders imagine gathering the whole earth and its like as a replacement at account. Nearby 13:14 has already pictured failed response as water without a conduit, and 13:20-22 will specify covenant, connection, and enacted good. I assign response the role of relational access and ransom the role of attempted commodity substitution. The packet supplies relation on one side and accumulated objects on the other; I infer an unformed relation cannot be retroactively replaced by external quantity. The bad account is therefore not merely a large debt but a category failure about what can count.

2. **The refuge becomes an anti-cradle.** `ء و ي / B001` is drawing into a sheltering point, while `م ه د / B001` is a child's prepared cradle and `م ه د / B002` a smoothed bedding. The fixed end joins a destination of shelter to a blame formula about bedding. I assign the cradle image the role of expected rest and protection, then let the evaluative reversal negate that function. The packet supplies shelter-language and a bad bed; I infer chosen nonresponse -> a destination that cannot perform shelter. The closing image reads as failed refuge, not only location.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:20-23 made the non-substitutability precise: covenant, connection, enacted maintenance, and repaired family entry are relations, not commodities. The imagined double earth cannot stand in for a response-channel never formed.

baseline.text: Rablerinin çağrısına karşılık verenler için en güzeli vardır. Ona karşılık vermeyenler ise yeryüzündeki her şeye ve bir o kadarına daha sahip olsalar, kurtulmak için hepsini verirlerdi. Onlar için kötü bir hesap vardır; varacakları yer cehennemdir. Ne kötü döşektir!

findings.text: Hesap, biriktirilen şeylerin miktarını değil, kurulmuş karşılık ilişkisini ölçer; bu yüzden bütün dünya bile hiç kurulmamış bir bağın yerine geçemez.
Cehennemin döşeği, sığınak gibi görünen fakat dinlenme ve koruma işlevini tersine çeviren başarısız bir beşik görüntüsü taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyi delip geçecek biçimde kesmeyi ortak çekirdek olarak verir; kaya oyma, yer kazma, giysi açıklığı açma ve boynuzun deriyi yararak çıkması bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu işlem ve sonuç ilişkisini doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, nesnede geçişli bir yarma veya kesme işlemiyle sınırlıdır; yer aşma, sözlü karşılık ve yalnızca oluşmuş boşluk bu çekirdeğe girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel delip kesme çekirdeğini, belirli yapılara bağlı giysi, kazma ve boynuz örneklerinden ayırır; bu özel kullanımlar yalın anlamın tamamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi yarıp öte yanına geçecek biçimde kesmek veya delmek; kaya oyma ve yer kazma bunun sert yüzey ya da zemin üzerindeki özel gerçekleşmeleridir. Giyside açıklık oluşturma ile boynuzun deriyi yararak dışarı çıkması da aynı geçişli yarılma düzenine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi, içinde geçişli bir açıklık oluşacak biçimde yarma, delme veya kesme işlemi.
Kayayı oyarak kesme ya da bir yeri kazıp çukurlaştırma, çekirdek işlemin sert yüzey ve zemin üzerindeki özel biçimleridir.
Giyside yaka açıklığı açmak ve boynuzun deriyi delerek çıkması, geçişli yarılmanın somut örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı delme ile kesmeyi tek bir geçişli işlemde birleştirir; giysi biçme, kaya oyma, kazma ve deriyi yararak çıkma bu işlemin farklı nesnelerdeki görünümleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın tüm özel gerçekleşmelerini yöneten geçişli yarma ve kesme çekirdeği için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem kesme işlemini hem de açıklığın öte yana geçmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kaya ya da zemin üzerinde oyma ve kazma yoluyla açıklık oluşturulan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı yer, ıssız alan, ülke ve geceyi baştan başa geçme hareketini; ayrıca bir ülkeden ötekine taşınan haberi aynı yol aşma düzeninde toplar. Sağlanan çerçeve hareket eden kişi ile taşınan haber arasındaki katılımcı değişimini de korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir alanı yol alarak aşmaktır; nesneyi fiziksel olarak delip kesme ve sözlü karşılık verme bu dala alınmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel yer aşma kullanımı, gece boyunca ilerleme ve haberin ülkeler arasında taşınması gibi yapıya bağlı uzantılardan ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yeri, ülkeyi ya da karanlık bir zaman aralığını yol alarak baştan başa geçmek. Aynı hareket düzeni, bir haberin uzak yerler arasında taşınmasına aktarılarak kullanılır.

facets.statement: Bir yeri veya ülkeyi yol alıp bir ucundan öteki ucuna geçerek aşma.
Bütün gece ilerlemek veya karanlığı yararak yol almak, alan aşma çekirdeğinin zamansal ve görsel olarak belirlenmiş biçimidir.
Haberin bir ülkeden ötekine taşınması, yol aşan kişinin hareketinin taşınan bilgiye aktarılmış uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yer ve ülke aşmayı ortak çekirdek olarak sunar; sürekli yol alan kişi, gece boyunca ilerleme ve uzak yerlerden taşınan haber bu çekirdeğin katılımcı ya da kapsam uzantılarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı söze veya soruya karşılık verme, karşılıklı konuşma, çağrıya yönelme ve isteği yerine getirme kullanımlarını açıkça birlikte sunar. Dal çerçevesi yalnız söylenen cevabı değil, çağrıya kabul ve uyma yoluyla verilen karşılığı da kapsadığı için kaynağa uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği bir söz, soru, çağrı veya isteğe yöneltilmiş karşılıktır; yer aşma ve fiziksel kesme bu ilişkinin parçası değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel karşılık verme çekirdeği, karşılıklı konuşma, çağrıya uyma ve yanlış işitmeye bağlı kalıplaşmış örneklerden ayrı katmanlarda tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir söze, soruya, çağrıya veya isteğe sözle ya da uygun eylemle karşılık vermek. Karşılıklı söz alışverişi bu işlemin iki yönlü biçimi, bir çağrıya uyma veya isteği yerine getirme ise eylemle gerçekleşen biçimidir.

facets.statement: Önceden yöneltilmiş bir söz veya soruya karşı söz üreterek karşılık verme.
Bir çağrıya yönelmek, ona uymak veya isteyenin dileğini yerine getirmek, karşılığın eylemle verilmiş uzantısıdır.
İki tarafın birbirine karşılık vererek konuşması, tek yönlü karşılığın karşılıklı konuşmaya genişlemiş biçimidir.
Yanlış işitmenin yanlış karşılığa yol açtığını anlatan kalıplaşmış söz, çekirdek ilişkinin sonuç bildiren bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılığı sözle verme ile çağrıya veya isteğe eylemle karşılık vermeyi aynı alanda toplar; karşılıklı konuşma iki tarafın art arda karşılık üretmesi olarak sunulur.

concept_gloss.text: söze ya da çağrıya karşılık verme
concept_gloss.applicability: Sözlü cevap, karşılıklı konuşma ve çağrıya uygun eylemle yönelme kapsamlarının ortak çekirdeğini taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı yerdeki çukur veya açık alanı, bulut ve dağlardaki aralığı, ortası boş nesneyi ve açılıp genişleyen oluşumu birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi bunların ortak sonucu olan açılmış ya da içi boşalmış alanı doğru biçimde yakalar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal oluşmuş açıklık, geniş boşluk veya ortası boş durumla ilgilidir; bu sonucu doğuran kesme işlemi ve yalnızca bir yerde ilerleme ayrı kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın açıklık ve boşluk çekirdeğinde kalır; belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlı ek bir okuma içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yerde, dağda, bulutta veya bir nesnenin ortasında açılmış, genişlemiş ya da boş kalmış alan. Bulutun açılması bu boşluğun oluşma sürecini, ortası oyuk nesne ise kalıcı sonucunu gösterir.

facets.statement: Bir yüzeyde veya iki bölüm arasında açılmış ve genişlemiş boşluk, aralık ya da çukur alan.
Yerdeki çukur alan ile bulut veya dağ arasındaki açıklık, çekirdeğin çevresel gerçekleşmeleridir.
Bir nesnenin ortasının boş veya oyuk olması, alansal açıklığın nesne yapısına uygulanmış uzantısıdır.
Bulutun açılıp dağılması, kapalı görünüm içinde bir açıklığın ortaya çıkma sürecidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yerdeki çukur alanı, bulut ve dağdaki aralığı ve ortası boş nesneyi genişlemiş açıklık ortaklığında birleştirir; bulutun dağılması bu açıklığın oluşmasını anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı kadınların giydiği bir zırh veya giysiyi, kalkanı, kesilmiş bir üstlüğü ve giysiyi üstüne geçirme eylemini açıkça aynı dalda sıralar. Sağlanan çerçeve bu adlandırmaları tek nesneye indirgemeden koruduğu için uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, giysi ve korunma nesnesi adları ile giysiyi üstüne geçirme eylemini kapsar; fiziksel kesme yalnız giysinin biçimini açıklayan arka plandır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalda tanıklanan giysi, zırh ve kalkan adlarını temel alır; giysiyi üstüne geçirme eylemi kaynakta verilen türemiş kullanım olarak ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_map.definition: Kadının giydiği zırh veya giysi, kesilmiş bir üstlük ya da savunmada kullanılan kalkan için kullanılan ad. Buna bağlı eylem, bir giysiyi bedene geçirip giymektir.

facets.statement: Kadının bedenine giydiği zırh veya koruyucu nitelikli giysi adı.
Aynı adın elde taşınan savunma aracı olan kalkanı belirtmesi ayrı bir nesne değeridir.
Kesilmiş bir tür üstlüğü belirtmesi, giysi alanındaki özel adlandırmadır.
Bir gömleği veya başka giysiyi bedene geçirip giymek, nesne adından ayrılan eylem kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kadın giysisi veya zırhı ile kalkanı ayrı nesne değerleri olarak verir; kesilmiş üstlük anlamı giysi alanını özelleştirir, giysiyi bedene geçirme ise eylem uzantısıdır.

concept_gloss.text: giysi, zırh veya kalkan; giysiyi üstüne geçirme
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın birbirinden ayrılan nesne adlarını ve bunlara bağlı giyinme eylemini eksiltmeden birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Giysi, bedene giyilen zırh, elde taşınan kalkan ve giyme eylemi ayrımlarını korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi dağınık durumdan bir araya getirmek ve onu kendisi için ya da belirli bir yerde elde bulundurur duruma getirmektir. Vergi veya ürün toplamak ve suyu bir su teknesinde biriktirmek bu işlemin özel uygulamalarıdır.

facets.statement: Dağınık ya da ayrı durumdaki şeyi bir araya getirip elde etmek.
Vergi, mal veya ürünleri yükümlü yerlerden toplayıp elde etmek.
Suyu bir su teknesinde bir araya getirip biriktirmek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bir şeyi toplamak ve elde etmektir; vergi, mal, ürün ve su bu işlemin belirtilen nesneleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel eylem çekirdeğini, hem bir araya getirme hem de elde bulundurma sonucuyla birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Toplama ve elde etme işlemini vergi bağlamında korur.
error_profile.loses: Vergi dışındaki nesnelerle kurulan genel toplama kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Suyun belirli bir su teknesinde toplanması anlatılırken kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü hem bir su teknesinde ya da başka bir yerde birikmiş suyu hem de suyun toplandığı geniş büyük tekneyi açıkça adlandırır. Çoğul biçim de bu büyük su teknelerine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir su teknesinde ya da başka bir yerde toplanmış suyu veya özellikle hayvanların su içtiği, suyu biriktiren geniş ve büyük tekneyi adlandırır. Büyük su teknelerinin çoğul adı da bu kapsamdadır.

Bu büyük su teknelerini topluca adlandıran çoğul biçim.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, önce bir yerde toplanan suyu, ardından bu suyu toplayan büyük ve geniş tekneyi verir; ayrıca tekne adının çoğul biçimini belirtir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Çevre toprağına dayalı çerçeve kaynakların çoğunu karşılar, ancak kaynak sözü bir yerde kuyunun kazılmış çukurunu da doğrudan anar. Bu nedenle dal yalnızca kuyunun dış çevresindeki yığına indirgenemez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir kişiyi yakına getirme, seçme ve başkalarından ayırarak ona özel bir yer verme yönlerini birlikte taşır. Yaratıcının kulunu seçmesi bu çekirdeğin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü öne eğilmiş ayakta duruşu, elleri dizlere koymayı, dizler üzerinde yüzüstü kapanmayı ve yere kapanmayı birlikte verir. Toplanma ise bağımsız bir toplama eylemi değil, bedenin bükülüp kendi üzerine çekilmesini açıklayan yön olarak anlaşılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bedensel duruş ve kapanmayla sınırlıdır; mal, su veya başka nesneleri toplama anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın duruş ve kapanma anlamlarını korur; bedensel toparlanma açıklamasını nesne toplama anlamına genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Ayaktayken gövdeyi öne eğip elleri dizlere koymak veya dizler üzerinde yüzüstü yere kapanmaktır. Her iki durumda da beden dik ve açık duruştan bükülmüş, kendi üzerine toplanmış bir duruşa geçer.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalda temel olarak bir seyi kesmeyi, ozellikle de kokunden ayirip koparmayi verir. Deve horgucunun kokunden kesilmesi ve igdis edilmis kisinin organlarinin alinmasi bu cekirdegin ozel uygulamalari olarak ayni sinir icinde kalir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Duyusal kesip ayirma cekirdektir; korkak adam ya da ayri kap anlamlari bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem yalın kesme adi hem de horguc ve igdis etme baglamlari vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir kokten kesme ekseninde ayirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir seyi bulundugu kokten veya taban bagindan keserek ayirma, yok etme ya da bu kesilmis halde bulunma anlamidir.

Kesme eyleminin sonucu olarak kesilmis horguclu hayvan veya kesilmis kisi nitelenir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: جبه إذا غلبه بحسنه أو غيره كأنه قطعه عن مساماته (maqayis)؛ والجب الغلبة (ayn)؛ جبت المرأة النساء إذا غلبتهن من حسنها (jamhara;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ فلان جب القوم إذا غلبهم (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi giyilen ve bedeni icine alarak saran bir giysiyi verir; zirh adi olarak kullanimi da giyilen koruyucu nesne sinirindadir. Bu dal, mızrak yuvasi veya ev ortasi gibi ic bosluk adlariyla karistirilmamalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal giyilen, bedeni saran esyaya aittir; soket, kuyu veya genel kap anlamlari ayridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin giysi adi ve zirh adi birlikte bulunur; tanim saran giyilebilir nesne sinirini korur.

concept_map.definition: Bedeni icine alip saran giyilebilir nesne, bunun cogulu ve zırh adi olarak kullanilan koruyucu giysi anlamidir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bedeni icine alan ve uzerinde tasinan giysidir.
Ayni ad koruyucu bir zırh icin de kullanilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar giyilen nesneyi ortak kabul eder ve onun bedeni sarmasi aciklamasini verir. Ek olarak zırh adi olarak kullanilmasi, giysi cekirdeginin koruyucu bir alt turu gibi belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Giyilen ana nesne ve zırh adi olarak koruyucu giysi kullanimi icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bedeni icine alma, giyilme ve zırh alt turunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gundelik giyim nesnesi olarak aktarimda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Giyilen ve bedeni saran nesne anlamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Zırh adi olarak kullanimi bu ifade icinde acikca gorunmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Koruyucu savas giysisi anlamindaki ozel kullanim icindir.

error_profile.preserves: Koruyucu giyilebilir nesne alt anlamini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda nesne giyilir ve bedeni sarar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dalda bir sey icine giren yuva veya bosluk anlatilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de icine alma ve sarma goruntusuyle temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bedene giyilen nesneyi anlatir; komsu dal mızrak ucu, goz, ev veya boynuz gibi yerlerdeki giris boslugunu anlatir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar giysi, sarma ve ic bosluk alanlarina yakindir; en yararli sinir giysi ile giris yuvasi arasindadir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجبة التي تلبس، وجمعها جباب وجبب، وما سمي من الدروع جبة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه تجاويف الرمح والعين والدار إلا من جهة صورة الدخول والاشتمال.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجبة معروفة لأنها تشمل الجسم وتجمعه فيها (maqayis)؛ الجباب جمع الجبة التي تلبس (ayn)؛ الجباب التي تلبس (sihah)؛ الجبة التي تلبس والجبة من أسماء الدروع (tahdhib)؛ الجبة التي هي اللباس منه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi mızrak ucuna giren sap yuvasi, goz cukuru, evin ortasi, hurma tomurcugunun ici ve boynuzdaki yer gibi icine girilen veya icte kalan yerleri birlikte verir. Bu, bagimsiz kuyu ya da giyilen giysi degil, belirli nesnelerdeki giris veya ic bosluk adidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal belirli nesne icindeki yuva ve ic boslukla sinirlidir; kuyu ve giysi dallari ayridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Cok sayida tamlama ve bir form kullanimi vardir; tanim yalın genel bosluk degil bu baglamlardaki giris yerlerini ayirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin baska bir seyin icine girdigi yuva ya da goz, ev, tomurcuk ve boynuz gibi yapilarda icte kalan bolum anlamidir.

facets.statement: Temel ortaklik, bir seyin icine girdigi veya icte kaldigi bosluk ve yuva olmasidir.
Mızrak ucuna sapin girdigi yer en belirgin teknik kullanimdir.
Goz cukuru, evin ortasi, tomurcugun ici ve boynuzdaki yer ayni ic bolum tasavvuruyla kullanilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar mızrak ucu yuvasi etrafinda ortaklasir ve bunu icine girilen yer olarak aciklar. Tek kaynakli ek ornekler goz, ev, hurma tomurcugu ve boynuzdaki ic bolumleri ayni sekle baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Mızrak ucu yuvasi ve benzer ic bolumler icin kisa, genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Giris yeri, ic bosluk ve baglama gore ic bolum anlamlarini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Silah parcasinda sapin girdigi yer anlatildiginda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Teknik giris yuvasi anlamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Goz, ev, tomurcuk veya boynuz gibi nesnelerdeki ic kisim aktariminda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Icte kalan bolum anlamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Mızrak ucuna giren teknik yuva ayrintisi gorunmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal nesne icindeki yuva veya ic kisimdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kuyu dali yeryuzunde acilmis su cukurunu anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de ic bosluk ve derinlik tasavvuruyla temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal mızrak ucu, goz veya ev gibi bir nesnenin ic bolumunu anlatir; komsu dal bagimsiz bir kuyu adidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar oyuk, ic bolum, kuyu ve giysi alanlarina dagilir; en belirgin okur karisikligi ic yuva ile kuyu arasindadir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جبة السنان أو الرمح، وحجاج العين، ووسط الدار، وداخل طلعة، وجب القرن، وكل موضع مصور كجوف يدخل فيه شيء.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه البئر المستقلة ولا اللباس، وإن اشتركت في صورة الجوف أو الاشتمال.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجبة ما دخل فيه ثعلب الرمح من السنان (maqayis)؛ جبة السنان أي مدخله (ayn)؛ الجبة ما دخل فيه الرمح من السنان (sihah)؛ جبة العين حجاجها وجبة الدار وسطها وجب طلعة داخلها وجب القرن الذي فيه المشاشة (tahdhib)؛ به شبه ما دخل فيه الرمح من السنان (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi deri parcalardan yapilan toprak tasima sepetini ve et, parca et veya eritilmis yag konan iskembe turu kabi birlikte verir. Ses veya iri yanlilik anlamlari acikca bu kapsamin disinda tutulmalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tasima ya da saklama kabi olan deri veya iskembe nesnesidir; ses ve beden iriligi anlamlari ayridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanim tamlama baglamina dayanmadan kap ve tasima nesnesi olarak kurulur.

concept_map.definition: Toprak tasimaya yarayan deri sepet ya da et, parca et ve eritilmis yag konan iskembe turu kap anlamidir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek ortaklik, malzeme koyulan ve tasinan deri veya iskembe kaynakli kap olmasidir.
Bir kullanimda toprak tasimak icin deriden yapilmis sepeti anlatir.
Baska kullanimda et, parca et veya eritilmis yag konan iskembe kabi anlatilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kap anlamini iki somut alanda verir: toprak tasiyan deri sepet ve yiyecek ya da yag konan iskembe kabi. Her iki kullanimda da nesne bir seyi icinde tutup tasimaya yarar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Toprak tasima sepeti ile yiyecek veya yag kabi anlamlarini ortak bir kap cekirdeginde karsilar.

error_profile.preserves: Deri sepet, iskembe kabi ve icinde malzeme bulundurma islevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Toprak tasimak icin kullanilan deri kap anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Deri sepet ve toprak tasima islevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Et, parca et veya yag konulan iskembe kabi icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yiyecek veya yag koyma islevini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: et veya yag konan iskembe kabi
bu kaba et parcalari koymak veya ona gore hazirlanmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal deri sepet veya iskembe kabi gibi tasima ve saklama kaplarini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal parcalari dikilerek yapilmis su tulumunu anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal da deri veya organ kaynakli kap alanina yakindir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal toprak, et ya da yag icin kullanilan kaplara aittir; komsu dal dikilmis su tulumu gibi belirli bir su kabi adidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Kap ve tasima komsulari coktur; yayinlanan ayrim ayni alan icindeki deri kap ile dikilmis su tulumu sinirini netlestirir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجبجبة بمعنى الزبيل من جلود ينقل فيه التراب، والكرش أو الوعاء الذي يجعل فيه اللحم أو الخلع أو الإهالة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجبجبة إذا أريد بها مجرد الصوت على رأي المفردات، ولا ضخامة الجنبين.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجبجبة زبيل من جلود يجمع فيه التراب والجبجبة الكرش يجعل فيه اللحم (maqayis)؛ الجبجبة الكرش يجعل فيها الخلع أو تذاب الإهالة فتحقن فيها والجبجبة أيضا زبيل من جلود ينقل فيه التراب (sihah)؛ الجبجبة زبيل من جلود ينقل فيه التراب والجبجبة الكرش يجعل فيها اللحم ويسمى الخلع (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskin bolumu insanlarin hurmayi asılamasini ve bunun zamanini verir. Bir kaynakta zamanin hasat zamaniyla yaklastirilmasi bulunsa da dal yalniz genel kesme anlamina indirgenemez; tanim hurma isleri baglamina bagli kalmalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hurma asilama isi ve mevsimiyle sinirlidir; genel kesme veya genel tarim zamani olarak genisletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam tamlama ve baglama baglidir; tanim hurma isini yalın kok anlamina cevirmeden verir.

concept_map.definition: Hurma agacini asılama isi ve bu isin yapildigi mevsim, kimi aktarimda hurma kesim zamaniyla iliskili zaman anlamidir.

facets.statement: Ana kullanim, insanlarin hurma agacini asılamasi eylemidir.
Ayni ad bu isin veya yakin hurma islerinin zamani icin kullanilir.
Bir aktarim zaman anlamini kesim zamaniyla yaklastirir, fakat dal hurma isleri baglaminda kalir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hurma asilama eylemini ve bunun zamani olarak kullanimi birlikte verir. Zamanin hurma kesim donemine yaklastirildigi aktarim, cekirdegi genis bir kesme anlamina degil hurma islerinin mevsimine baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hurma agaciyla ilgili bu ozel is ve onun mevsimi soz konusu oldugunda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Asılama eylemini, zaman anlamini ve hurma baglamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Insanlarin hurma agacina uyguladigi eylem anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hurma asilama eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Zaman bildirimi olarak gecen kullanimlarda, asilama veya kesimle iliskili donemi aciklar.

error_profile.preserves: Zaman ve hurma isi baglamini korur.
error_profile.adds: Asilama ile kesim arasindaki kesin ayrimi gevsetir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: hurma asilama veya hurma isleri zamani

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal hurma isine bagli asilama ve zaman adidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal genel kokten kesip ayirma eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi bazi aktarimlarda kesim zamani imgesiyle temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hurma agaci uzerindeki belirli tarim isine ve mevsime baglidir; komsu dal herhangi bir nesnenin kokunden kesilmesine aittir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komsular hurma, bitki cikisi ve kesme alanindadir; yayinlanan ayrim kollokasyon sinirini korumak icindir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جب الناس النخل، وزمن الجباب، حيث فسرت المصادر الفعل بتلقيح النخل أو جعلته زمنا من أعمال النخل.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أصل القطع العام إلا حيث ربطه المفردات بزمن الصرام.
branches.source_phrase_ar: وجب الناس النخل إذا ألقحوه وذا زمن الجباب (maqayis)؛ الجباب أيضا تلقيح النخل وقد جب الناس النخل (sihah)؛ إذا لقح الناس النخيل قيل قد جبوا وقد أتانا زمن الجباب (tahdhib)؛ كجب النخل وقيل زمن الجباب نحو زمن الصرام (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yeryuzunun sert ve kalin yuzunu, sert topragi ve koparilan iri toprak kesegini verir. Kuyu anlami burada yalniz kazilabilecek zeminle temas eder, dalin kendisi kuyu degildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sert ve kalin toprak yuzeyidir; kuyu veya su cukuru anlamina kaydirilmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanim collocation baglamindan degil toprak yuzeyi adi olarak kurulur.

concept_map.definition: Yeryuzunun sert, kalin veya kaba toprakli yuzeyi ve bu yuzeyden koparilan iri toprak kesegi anlamidir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam sert, kalin veya kaba yeryuzu tabakasidir.
Bu yuzeyden koparilan iri toprak kesegi de ayni alana baglanir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sert veya kalin yeryuzu anlaminda ortaklasir; bazilari bunu dogrudan yuzey, bazilari kalin toprak olarak verir. Iri kesek aktarimi bu sert yuzeyden koparilan parcaya uzanir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yeryuzunun kaba ve sert tabakasi ile ondan kopan iri kesek icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sertlik, kalin toprak yuzeyi ve kesek uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yeryuzunun sert tabakasi anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sert yuzey ve yeryuzu anlamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yerden koparilan kaba kesek anlaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Koparilan iri kesek anlamini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yerden koparilan iri sert toprak kesegi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sert yer yuzeyi veya kesegidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal su icin acilmis kaplanmamis kuyu adidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal yeryuzu ve kazilmis ya da sert zemin alaninda temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal zeminin niteligini anlatir; komsu dal bu zeminde acilabilecek belirli bir su cukurunu adlandirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komsular sert zemin, yuzey ve kuyu alanlarindadir; yayinlanan ayrim sert zemin ile kuyu adini ayirir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجبوب ووجه الأرض الصلبة، والأرض الغليظة، والمدرة أو الجبوبة المقتلعة من وجه الأرض.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه البئر إلا إذا ذكرت الأرض الصلبة بوصفها موضع حفره.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجبوب الأرض الغليظة (maqayis)؛ الجبوب وجه الأرض الصلبة (ayn)؛ الجبوب الأرض الغليظة ويقال وجه الأرض (sihah)؛ الجبوب وجه الأرض والأرض الغليظة والأرض الصلبة والمدر المفتت (tahdhib)؛ جبوب أي أرض غليظة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yolun ana caddesi ve toplandigi yer anlamini verir; birinin bu ana yola girmesi de ayni adla aktarilir. Sert toprak ya da kuyu anlamlariyla benzerlik alan degil, yalniz yolun belirli cizgisi uzerindedir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yolun ana ve islek hattiyla sinirlidir; zemin niteligi veya kuyu anlamina genisletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanim yalin yol adi olarak verilir ve diger collocation anlamlari iceri alinmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yolun ana caddesi, gidisin toplandigi islek orta hatti ya da bu ana yol uzerinden gitme anlamidir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam yolun ana, islek ve toplayici hattidir.
Bu ana hatta binmek veya onu izlemek de ayni kullanimda yer alir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dali ana yol ve yolun toplandigi hat anlaminda verir. Bir aktarimda bu yola binme veya onu izleme ifadesi, adin pratik kullanimini gosterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yolun islek, acik ve gidisi toplayan ana cizgisi icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ana yol, yolun toplayici hatti ve onu izleme kullanimini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yolun genis ve temel gidis hatti anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ana yol anlamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin bu yol hattina girdigi veya onu izledigi baglamlarda kullanilir.
